entries.title: Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice
entries.definitive_edition: Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice Enhanced on Windows PC plus VR Edition

emulation.notes: Use the enhanced PC build; install the included VR Edition only if a headset is available.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Enhanced PC ray tracing/DLSS/FSR route plus optional PC VR Edition.

primary.version: Enhanced PC release plus VR Edition
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best version because the PC enhancement update adds ray-traced reflections and shadows, DLSS, FSR, and DirectX 12 support while the Steam purchase also includes the separate VR Edition. That covers both the highest-tweakable flat-screen route and the unique VR mode on the same platform.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Hellblade: Senua's Sacrifice on Steam for Windows PC, update to the enhanced build, and install the included VR Edition if you want the optional VR playthrough.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced updates improve visuals and performance options but do not add new story content; PS5 haptics are a platform feature rather than exclusive gameplay content.

entries.title: Senua's Saga: Hellblade II
entries.definitive_edition: Senua's Saga: Hellblade II Enhanced on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the current Enhanced PC build; no console emulation route is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC Enhanced presentation with Very High graphics preset.

primary.why: The Windows PC Enhanced Edition is the best route because the Enhanced update adds the full post-launch feature set and the PC version gets a Very High graphics preset in addition to PC capture/settings flexibility. PS5 and Xbox Series versions share the enhanced content but not the PC-specific graphics ceiling.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Senua's Saga: Hellblade II on Steam or Xbox on PC, update to the Enhanced version, and play the standard campaign first; use Dark Rot mode and developer commentary after the main completion.

entries.remaster_caveats: Enhanced is a post-launch update/edition with new modes and technical features, not a separate sequel or remake.
